8129.title: Repository-wide plugin dependencies on trusted main
8129.rootCauseOneLine: Trusted main materializes the full commit tree; the sparse-checkout change is unmerged, so none of the reported install failures occurs in the tested baseline.

prReviews.verdict: NOT DYNAMICALLY VALIDATED — static inspection only
prReviews.topFinding: The proposed fallback and cache adoption match the alleged mechanism, but neither linked branch was executed; an open linked PR also prevents a duplicate fix.

8129.proposedFix: No production fix on this baseline. Rerun the saved install probes when sparse checkout reaches trusted main, then cover update staging and candidate probes if failures occur.
8129.caveats: Five install checks passed in two clean trusted checkouts. Confidence is high for main's full-tree behavior, not a runtime finding about the unmerged sparse proposal. Linux only; updates and candidate probes not exercised.
